narr: Thunderstorms moved west across southeast Arizona. Thunderstorm winds downed power lines in Patagonia while heavy rain caused flash flooding in the Baboquivari Mountains.
ev: Heavy rain of 3-4 inches in 2 hours caused flash flooding across State Route 286 and 2-3 inches of rain caused flash flooding and the closure of Sasabe-Arivaca Road at mile post 2.
lsr: SASABE ARIVACA RD CLOSED DUE TO FLOODING AT MILE POST 2.
